description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'EmployeeDistributionByLocation' within the OrangeHRM system, encapsulating information related to employee distribution across locations, including counts and limits.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionByLocation
classes.description: A DTO class that holds employee distribution data across various locations, including counts for specific locations, unassigned employees, and overall limits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DTO with location count pairs and various employee count metrics.

methods.name: getLocationCountPairs
methods.description: Returns the array of location count pairs.

methods.name: getOtherEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees not assigned to specific locations.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees without an assigned location.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit on the number of locations displayed or considered.

methods.name: getTotalLocationCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of locations considered.
